question: What three-syllable mantra is declared to grant all desired purposes?
premises: It is declared the giver of all purposes
inference: The three-syllable mantra hrāṃhrīṃsaḥ is declared to grant all purposes.
plain_english: Its three-syllable mantra is declared to be 'hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ', the giver of all purposes.
